children: Zions Bancorporation appointed Brian Stringham as Senior Vice President and Corporate Controller, effective September 7, 2026, with Jason Arbuckle moving to Senior Director of Corporate Finance and Transformation.
Senior Vice President and Corporate Controller (Bank's principal accounting officer)
Senior Director of Corporate Finance and Transformation
Succeeded as Corporate Controller by Brian Stringham

Joined Bank in 2003; Assistant Corporate Controller and Director of External Financial Reporting since 2020; oversaw SEC and regulatory reporting; previously responsible for accounting/reporting of credit and lending activities.
